question: What earthly enjoyment and final destination await the endowed worshipper?
premises: The worshipper is endowed with all sovereignties
The worshipper enjoys happiness in this world
After enjoyment the worshipper goes to Hari
inference: Endowed with all sovereignties, the worshipper enjoys happiness here and then goes to Hari.
plain_english: Endowed with all sovereignties, having enjoyed happiness here, one should go to Hari.
